description: This file defines the SurveysViewReports class, a PHP class extending SugarView, responsible for generating survey report views in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for fetching survey statistics, processing survey responses, and generating data structures for various question types in surveys.

classes.name: SurveysViewReports
classes.description: A PHP class extending SugarView, responsible for rendering survey reports, including gathering survey statistics, processing responses, and preparing data for display.

methods.name: getSurveyStats
methods.description: Fetches the number of survey responses sent and distinct responses for a specific survey.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to generate and display the survey report, including response processing and data preparation.

methods.name: getCheckboxQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Initializes data structure for checkbox type questions.

methods.name: getMatrixQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Initializes data structure for matrix type questions.

methods.name: getChoiceQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Initializes data structure for choice-based questions like radio, dropdown, multiselect.

methods.name: getRatingQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Initializes data structure for rating questions.

methods.name: getScaleQuestionSkeleton
methods.description: Initializes data structure for scale questions.

methods.name: generateSkeletonData
methods.description: Generates initial data skeleton for survey questions based on their type.
